args.query:
SELECT cohort, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN recovered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) AS recovery_rate
FROM medical_trial.csv
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

